d:
is bhajan ka bhav bahut sundar hai—jab prabhu shri ram hamare rakshak aur sahara hain, to phir kisi bat ki chinta kaisi! anuradha paudval ke svaron men yah bhajan bhakton ko shri ram ki sharan aur vishvas ka sandesh deta hai |
Prastut hai bhagvan shri ram ki atut bhakti, vishvas aur samarpan se paripurn sundar bhajan "hamare hain shri raghunath hamen kis bat ki chinta", anuradha paudval ji ke madhur svaron men.
Yah bhaktimay bhajan hamen yad dilata hai ki jo bhakt prabhu shri ram ki sharan men rahta hai, use jivan ki har paristhiti men prabhu ka sahara aur aashirvad prapt hota hai.
